units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 106a:1">B. Mets. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>כל העולם כולו בש׳ וכ׳</he> if the whole world (all the fields around) was stricken with blast, and his with mildew.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 106a:1">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 9:1">Arakh. IX, 1</cite> <he>היתה שנת ש׳ וירקון</he> if a year of blast or mildew intervened; a. fr.
